_note: Measured from src/svg/logo-display.svg (and logo-small, logo-line): ratio = height/width of the viewBox; line2 = ink width of AI CLUB / DARTMOUTH; line1_bottom = bottom of the DARTMOUTH ink / height. The build checks display.ratio against the SVG; measure line2 again by hand if the logo changes. Lockups: TeX Gyre Heros Bold, kerned. Display (the giant home title): tracking -0.045 em, baseline to baseline 0.81 em, so the gap between the lines is about 8% of the letter height. Small (header and footer): tracking -0.010 em, baseline to baseline 0.84 em (about 12%): a little more open, so it stays crisp at 104-116 px on standard screens.
